decisions.reason: The same client acceptance already has a candidate MODIFY recording blurbs and quotes as text-break elements; the placeholder method belongs to the source Requirement and requires no additional candidate change.
Using placeholders to request supplemental images does not change author names, author photographs, attribution coverage, or photo sourcing.
The placeholder method identifies where additional images are needed but does not change the requirement to enhance the quality of existing image assets.
The accepted placeholder method does not alter the magazine's visual style, branding reference, or color-use constraints.
The supplemental-image placeholder workflow does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The accepted approach for identifying supplemental-image needs does not change the digital launch target or deadline.
